name: ai-usage-lens
description: Analyze user-provided usage ledgers and explain estimated costs with transparent manual optimization guidance.

interface.longDescription: Offline analysis of user-selected request ledgers and dated rates. Reports missing usage and unknown prices explicitly; suggestions are manually applied. The skills-only package does not connect accounts or intercept prompts.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my usage ledger and dated price table.
Explain unknown costs without filling missing data.
